MOD = 10**9 + 7

def count_ways_to_recover_scroll(words):
    n = len(words)
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    dp[0] = 1
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        dp[i] = dp[i - 1]
        for j in range(i - 1, -1, -1):
            if words[j] <= words[i - 1]:
                dp[i] = (dp[i] + dp[j]) % MOD
                break
    
    return dp[n]
